﻿# Airship
> Cross-Channel Customer Experiences for the Mobile Era
## Overview
Airship delivers personalized messages and interactions that convert across mobile, web, email, SMS, wallet and more—fueled by real-time data, AI and unified orchestration.
## Customer Experience Platform
### Platform
- [**Orchestrate with customer journeys** - Unify cross-channel messages with app and web destinations where customers convert.](https://www.airship.com/platform/orchestrate-customer-journeys/)
- [**Fine tune with experimentation** - Transform experiments into measurable growth with robust testing that validates concepts and automatically scales what works.](https://www.airship.com/platform/fine-tune-with-experimentation/)
- [**Collect customer data** - Collect, enrich, and activate customer insights instantly to drive conversion with personalized, cross-channel experiences.](https://www.airship.com/platform/collect-customer-data/)
- [**Accelerate results with Airship AI** - Empower your team with collaborative agents that turn your strategies into dynamic, personalized experiences at scale.](https://www.airship.com/platform/accelerate-results-with-ai/)
- [**Build no-code experiences** - Build cross-channel experiences without limits](https://www.airship.com/platform/build-no-code-experiences/)
- [**Hyper personalize experiences** - Make every customer interaction uniquely theirs](https://www.airship.com/platform/hyper-personalize-experiences/)
- [**Boost customer acquisition** - Elevate visibility in app stores while converting web visitors into identified, opted-in customers.](https://www.airship.com/platform/boost-customer-acquisition/)
### Channels
- [**Push notifications** - Reach customers instantly on mobile](https://www.airship.com/channels/push-notifications/)
- [**SMS/RCS/MMS** - Build connections with smarter, richer messaging](https://www.airship.com/channels/rich-communication-services/)
- [**Email** - Email that powers the entire customer lifecycle](https://www.airship.com/channels/email/)
- [**Mobile wallet** - Turn mobile wallets into daily touchpoints](https://www.airship.com/channels/mobile-wallet/)
### Capabilities
- [**Customer data management** - Activate, collect, and unify customer data](https://www.airship.com/capabilities/customer-data-management/)
- [**Surveys** - Understand your audiences with robust surveys and forms ](https://www.airship.com/capabilities/surveys/)
- [**Recommendations & audience pulse** - Turn user-activity into actionable insights with tier-based reports and AI-powered recommendations.](https://www.airship.com/capabilities/recommendations-audience-pulse/)
- [**Scenes** - Build powerful app and website experiences instantly](https://www.airship.com/capabilities/scenes/)
- [**Performance analytics** - Unlock real-time, user-level insights to optimize journeys, improve customer experiences, and prove measurable business impact.](https://www.airship.com/capabilities/performance-analytics/)
- [**Integrations** - Ensure seamless data flow with Airship integrations](https://www.airship.com/capabilities/integrations/)
- [**Real-time data streams** - Transform live behaviors into immediate triggers for highly relevant, personalized experiences.](https://www.airship.com/capabilities/real-time-data-streams/)
### Conversion Destinations
- [**App** - Create dynamic, unified app experiences to accelerate acquisition, activation, engagement, and loyalty across the customer lifecycle.](https://www.airship.com/conversion-destinations/app/)
- [**Web** - Boost conversion with hyper-personalized web experiences](https://www.airship.com/conversion-destinations/web/)
## Use Cases
- [**Acquisition**](https://www.airship.com/use-case/acquisition/)
- [**Onboarding**](https://www.airship.com/use-case/onboarding/)
- [**Upsell & Cross-sell**](https://www.airship.com/use-case/upsell-cross-sell/)
- [**Retargeting**](https://www.airship.com/use-case/retargeting/)
- [**Churn prevention**](https://www.airship.com/use-case/churn-prevention/)
- [**Win back**](https://www.airship.com/use-case/win-back/)
## Industries Served
- [Media & Entertainment](https://www.airship.com/industry/media-entertainment/)
- [Retail](https://www.airship.com/industry/retail/)
- [Travel & Hospitality](https://www.airship.com/industry/travel-hospitality/)
- [Sports](https://www.airship.com/industry/sports/)
- [Financial & Insurance](https://www.airship.com/industry/finance-insurance/)
- [Telecom](https://www.airship.com/industry/telecom/)
## Company Information
- **Founded**: 2009 (as Urban Airship)
- **Rebranded**: To Airship
- **Headquarters**: San Francisco
- **Global Offices**: As of November 2025, Airship has offices in San Francisco, Portland, Santa Barbara, New York City, London, Paris, New Delhi, Munich, and Singapore.
- **CEO**: Brett Caine (formerly president of Citrix Online)
## Key Customers
- Ulta Beauty
- Vodafone
- Alaska Airlines
- Accuweather
- Ace Hardware
- Sky
- ASDA
- Orange France
- Various enterprise brands across retail, media, sports, and financial services

Trusted by the world’s leading brands
explore case studies 
Your brand at the center of their world
Mobile isn’t a channel. It’s the remote control to your customers’ lives. Design unified cross-channel experiences — across push, SMS, email, in-app, web, wallet, and more — that match the way today’s consumers discover, decide, and convert.
build
orchestrate
optimize
 
 
Build
From idea to launch without a single line of code
Create rich, native experiences across app and web, including forms, surveys, and branching layouts powered by AI agents. Do it truly no-code, with no custom HTML or JavaScript overlays. Simply build, preview, and deploy in a matter of moments — not months.
learn more 
80%
faster alerts
AccuWeather relies on Airship to launch breaking weather alerts consistently faster than competitors, achieving near-instant delivery when seconds count.
“Airship’s no-code editor made it possible for our entire team to create and optimize several multi-screen app onboarding experiences in minutes not months, without developer resources or app updates, which is absolutely critical for apps like SXSW GO...”
Michael Brown
Vice President of Innovation, SXSW
 
 
ORCHESTRATE
Cross-channel journeys in perfect rhythm
Say goodbye to disjointed message blasts. Use Airship AI to build goal-based roadmaps in seconds, then deliver seamless experiences that exceed customer expectations. We orchestrate the entire journey to meet customers on the channels they choose — from web to email to mobile wallet and more — and ensure every interaction is personalized.
learn more 
6.5x
lift in registrations
With Airship’s cross-channel approach, Hawaiian Airlines saw a double-digit YoY boost in audience engagement and a 6.5x lift in registrations upon first app opening.
“Mobile banking experiences require a high-touch strategy that keeps customers informed, engaged, and reassured. Airship empowered us to deliver it.”
Merlyn Tsai
Head of Consumer Banking & Digital, CIMB Singapore
 
 
optimize
Real-time intelligence that drives real results
Understand your customers. Learn what works. Then do more of it. With Airship, you can collect zero-party data, have Airship AI predict when your customers are ready to act, and test multiple variants at once. No friction, no guesswork — just enriched customer insights that fuel deeper personalization at scale.
learn more 
800x
higher response rates
With Airship’s adaptable experiences and A/B testing, Orange received 800x more survey responses in 24 hours and 30x higher monthly rates, boosting their NPS by 9 points.
“Our team was able to build a new and innovative experience for our guests when they were actively engaged with our app, capturing valuable insights to deliver more tailored recommendations.”
Jodi Williams
Vice President of E-Commerce, Ulta Beauty
Total Economic Impact™ of Airship: 476% ROI
A commissioned study conducted by Forrester Consulting on behalf of Airship found that Airship delivered 476% ROI for a composite organization made of six real enterprise customers.
ACCESS THE STUDY 
 
AIRSHIP AGENTS
The first live AI agents purpose-built for customer experience
While other platforms are still piloting AI features in beta, Airship’s agents are already elevating and accelerating workflows — from strategy recommendations through campaign creation and optimization.
You set the goals and approve the outputs. They handle the complexity.
learn more 
 
From prompt to live experience in minutes
Describe what you need, upload an image, or just have a simple conversation. Airship’s Scenes Agent builds native, on-brand, deeply embedded app and web experiences quickly without a single line of code.
 
Proactive strategy recommendations tied to your needs
Airship’s Recommendation Agent works from your real-time audience data, analyzing customer movement over time and surfacing actionable next steps that match your specific conversion goals.
 
Agents designed to work together with you in the loop
Our Campaign, Journey, Scenes, Accessibility, and Brand Guideline Agents are built to collaborate — so you get a unified output you can review and approve at every step.

AIRSHIP PRICING
Platform pricing designed for results
Our pricing reflects what makes us different: an intelligent, cross-channel platform that's built to deliver real business outcomes, not vanity metrics
 
Thank you
A team member will be in touch shortly.
Airship Experience Platform (AXP)
Orchestrate the entire customer lifecycle — from data capture to lasting loyalty — on one unified platform built for scale, so you can deliver ROI and increase your speed to market with experiences that convert. Leverage Airship AI to deliver personalized experiences at scale through a human-led approach that keeps your team in total control.
Core platform capabilities include:
get a quote 
Unified cross-channel experiences
across email, SMS/RCS/MMS, push notifications, web notifications, mobile wallet, app, and web
Customer data management
that activates existing data and captures zero-party preferences in real time for richer customer profiles
Personalization and segmentation
that create dynamic customer segments based on real-time behaviors, preferences, and context
Journey orchestration
that connects messaging, app, and web experiences into unified flows that guide customers to where they convert
Testing and optimization
solutions that continuously learn and automatically improve timing, content, and channels to maximize business results
Partner integrations
that connect to your existing stack — including leading CRMs, CDPs, and commerce platforms — with no custom development required
Reporting analytics
that track what matters — conversions, revenue, and retention — with customizable dashboards and clear attribution
Strategic services
from an expert team that helps you maximize value from implementation to optimization with tailored onboarding, training, and guidance
get a quote 
Airship Essentials
A self-service platform with no code required — best for growth-focused teams building high-impact app and web experiences with native UI, automation, and real-time orchestration
START WITH ESSENTIALS
